description.en: A native DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin bridging dsh coding agents to Feishu/Lark group chats — one group, one project directory.
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Structural code intelligence for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — gives the agent codegraph and codegraph_index tools to find where a symbol is declared, what calls it, and what a change   reaches, from a tree-sitter index it builds itself. Compatible with the codegraph CLI's on-disk format.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供代码结构分析工具，快速定位符号声明、调用关系及变更影响范围。

description.en: SillyTavern preset mode, macro engine and editor for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接加载和编辑 SillyTavern 预设，发消息前按顺序注入内容并控制工具。

description.en: ChatGPT-style select→ask for DeepSeek Harness Web: select text in a conversation, a floating 「询问 DeepSeek」 button appears — click it to quote the selection into the composer.
description.zh: 在对话中选中文本，一键引用到输入框，快速追问 DeepSeek，省去复制粘贴的麻烦。

description.en: Reads the files that AGENTS.md references with @path imports and injects their content into model context at session start, with byte budgets, compaction re-seeding and a six-language settings card.
description.zh: 把 AGENTS.md 里 @路径 引用的文件读出来，在会话启动时注入模型上下文；带字节预算、压缩后重新注入和六语言设置卡片。

description.en: Loom Chat is a DSH Web client plugin that turns linear ordinary sessions into a pannable, zoomable Loom-style canvas for parallel exploration.
description.zh: 把普通对话变成可缩放平移的无限画布，让你并行探索多个话题，聊天不再是一条线。

description.en: Discord Rich Presence for Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi, and DeepSeek Harness, powered by one local service that keeps your active work visible in Discord.
description.zh: 把 Codex、Claude Code 等 AI 编码工具的当前工作状态同步到 Discord，让队友随时看到你在忙什么。

description.en: deepseek harness 皮肤插件。支持选择本地目录下的图片作为背景设置
DSH web plugin: better-sidebar Git Remotes tab for fetch / ff-only pull / confirmed push
Serves the live opencode Go model catalog from the harness's built-in opencode-go provider route.
description.zh: 让 DSH 自带的 opencode-go 供应商跟随 opencode Go 套餐的实时模型列表，opencode 上架新模型后无需改配置即可使用。

description.en: Cross-session usage & cost observatory for the DeepSeek Harness web profile — trend/heatmap dashboards, per-model peak-hour pricing (CNY/USD), official DeepSeek balance with spend reconciliation.
description.zh: 跨会话统计 DeepSeek Harness 的用量与费用，提供趋势热力图、分时段价格和余额对账，帮你掌握成本。

description.en: Poppin'Party Live2D 桌宠插件 for DeepSeek Harness (local models, zero external deps)
不用一直在电脑前，远程操控Deepseek Harness，在飞书 / 企业微信 / Telegram 里指挥 DeepSeek Harness：远程派活 · 结果通知 · 危险操作审批
description.zh: 在飞书、企业微信或 Telegram 里远程指挥 DeepSeek Harness，派活、收通知、审批危险操作。

description.en: DSH 蒸馏主管：把一本书蒸馏成可执行 Agent 技能的判态制元技能（三闸判态·零🔴门禁）｜V4.9.3 发行自足：§21 强制门禁 gate_start/gate_stage/gate_checklist 与整套门禁套件（27 件）随包发行，发版闸 A/B/C/D/D-配套/E/F 六判据
description.zh: 把一本书蒸馏成一组可执行的 Agent 技能，三道闸门把关，只判态不打分，零红灯才放行。

description.en: Local-first voice conversations for DSH. Run speech recognition and speech synthesis on your own machine, with optional external providers.
description.zh: 在本地跑语音识别和合成，让 DSH 能听会说，语音聊天不用联网。

description.en: DSV4.1 reasoning support for DeepSeek Harness: lean analysis, images and attachments, and bounded acceptance/repair loops that aim to retain minimal-mode reasoning in a full agent.

Mobile fixes for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: on narrow (≤720px) screens the input bar and AI confirmation cards scroll with the page instead of pinning to the viewport floor, edges slim down, session switches no longer auto-focus the input, workspace row
以 dsh-bridge 为根基的 DSH 远程访问网关：局域网 / Cloudflare 隧道 / Tailscale 隧道 / 自建隧道 / 公网直连网关 / IM Bot，全部在 Web 面板中配置。
DSH 插件：在左侧栏底部显示 DeepSeek 账户余额（原生 UI），设置页提供连接、展示币种、预警阈值与刷新节奏的配置卡片。（原生嵌入“设置-插件-插件配置”）
把「社区」装进 DSH：一个类 Discord 的社区插件 —— 在 DeepSeek Harness 面板内实时聊天、@ 提醒、贴图传文件、管理成员与权限。
面向 DeepSeek Harness 的场景化 Agent 预设，覆盖单人交付、团队委派、方案调研和优化实验。Scenario-focused DeepSeek Harness agent presets for solo delivery, team delegation, evidence-based research, and optimization experiments.
dsh (DeepSeek Harness) 跨 agent 信箱插件：mailbox_send/check/reply/list/done/broadcast + task_create/list，桥接 agent-mailbox，零依赖 Node 22
description.zh: 给你的 dsh 智能体装个信箱，能和本机其他 AI 智能体互相收发消息、派发任务。

description.en: dsh memory: Nocturne Memory client for DeepSeek Harness
ego lite browser automation for dsh that remembers — recall a site's learned tools, promote a working script into a new one, hand the user the keyboard for real. 7 tools, host-only, MIT.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 用的轻量浏览器自动化插件，能记住网站操作技巧，把脚本升级成新工具，还能随时把控制权交还给你。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的完整 Git 管理插件：分支切换/fetch/pull/commit/push，可折叠悬浮面板 + 输入框胶囊
DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件:论文伴读工作台 —— PDF 转录 / 检索 / 流式问答 + 内置阅读器页面。
⚡️ Ultra-fast trigram-indexed code search for DeepSeek Harness powered by Microsoft tgrep.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上超快的三元组索引代码搜索，找代码秒出结果。

description.en: DSH 工具管理插件：按 Agent Preset 开关和分组工具，像 Skill 一样按需加载工具，减少模型上下文占用。
description.zh: 按 Agent Preset 开关和分组工具，让低频工具像 Skill 一样按需加载，省下模型上下文。

description.en: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件：为纯文本主模型补上识图能力。它把图片理解委托给你配置的一个小参数多模态模型，再把结果以文本形式交还给主模型；当活跃模型自身支持图片输入时，插件完全退避，原生多模态体验不受任何影响。
禁AI腔清单能让模型不像 AI，这个插件让它像你：把候选稿摊开成连续正文，作者只点 👍/👎，标注压成可复用的写作规律——只有规律进模型上下文，原文另存不进上下文。（DeepSeek Harness 插件）
[推理强度滑动调节插件]Reasoning effort slider for DeepSeek Harness — a per-session UI that lets users adjust reasoning intensity with a polished slider, shown for any model that declares reasoning efforts.
description.zh: 在对话输入框加个推理强度滑块，随时调节模型的思考深度，按会话生效。

description.en: Intent fitting for DSH: the agent predicts a few directions, asks in batches, and converges one — before it acts. 记忆拟合：先立靶子再问，收敛后提案待确认。
description.zh: 让 AI 动手前先问清楚：预测几个方向、批量提问、收敛成一个再提方案等你确认。

description.en: Customize the interface font, size, weight, color and layout from the settings page, Word-style and WYSIWYG, auto-saved. Ships two bundled open-source fonts (STIX2Text, Latin Modern Mono Light) plus an author-recommended typography, and stores settings under ~/.dsh.
description.zh: 在设置页里像 Word 一样改界面字体、字号、加粗、颜色与版式，所见即所得、自动保存。自带两套开源字体（STIX2Text、Latin Modern Mono Light）与一套作者推荐排版，设置存在 ~/.dsh（换桌面外壳不丢）。

description.en: A synthwave style DeepSeek Harness(dsh) theme
description.zh: 给 DSH Web UI 换上合成波风格，霓虹发光、背景轮播/视频，面板还能半透明，安装即用。

description.en: Plugin environment backup and migration for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 一条命令把 DeepSeek Harness 插件环境备份到 GitHub 仓库，换设备也能一键还原。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web plugin: live account balance as a colour-banded vertical progress bar on the right edge of the GUI, with an animated wave above the threshold.
GME Test Generator workflow tools for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): pick interfaces, generate and repair tests through a local Python backend, poll progress, and decide with consent.
Kinich and Ajaw theme for DeepSeek Harness Web with three visual styles, session-state feedback, companion interactions, and configurable ambient effects.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 Kinich 与 Ajaw 主题，提供三种视觉风格、会话状态反馈、伙伴交互和可配置的动态环境效果。

description.en: deepseek-harness嵌入一个小说阅读功能，防止打瞌睡
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面里直接看网络小说，导入书源就能搜索、加书架、滚动阅读，还能让 AI 帮你找书读章节。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns each agent reply into a short slide deck in plain language — for people who use the harness but do not read code.

One-click restart for DeepSeek Harness: a web button (plus a dsh_restart agent tool) hands the relaunch to a detached helper, the page reconnects by itself, and a recovery console shows the boot errors when the new host fails
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个一键重启按钮，装完插件点一下就能生效，页面自动重连，启动报错也能看到。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: stops the sandbox escalation fields being advertised to a model when the calling session cannot grant them, fixing the retry loop known models fall into at danger-full-access.
dsh plugin: customize UI theme with presets, accent colors, density, radius, fonts, and custom CSS
Measure whether a change to your dsh setup actually helped: register repeatable cases, run them, diff before/after. DeepSeek Harness plugin.
9router-backed web search + fetch providers for DeepSeek Harness (ctx.web). Wires the native web_search/web_fetch tools to 9router's /v1/search and /v1/web/fetch endpoints.
description.zh: 9router 网页搜索与网页抓取 provider，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供搜索和抓取能力。

description.en: DSH plugin: WeChat floating-ball bridge (QR login, message relay to agent) — maintained fork of lubaiUwU/DSH-WeChatClawBot with context_token + login-loop fixes
Paired Endeavour and Challenger agents for DeepSeek Harness.

Cross-session call center for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) agents: session_message delivery between sessions + a named contacts directory with name-only self-registration. File-based config, local-only, no telemetry.
description.zh: 让 DSH 智能体跨会话互发消息，并支持按名称注册联系人的轻量通讯录，实现多智能体协作。

description.en: Multi-agent task decomposition, DAG workflow orchestration, and prompt caching optimizer for DeepSeek Harness
Registers any set of HTTP APIs as paired doc-query and request tools for the agent.
description.zh: 把任意一套 HTTP 接口注册成 agent 可用的文档查询与请求双工具。

description.en: DSH plugin that prices an automatic context rewrite before it lands and asks first — the cold re-read, in k tokens.

DeepSeek Harness plugin for macOS desktop automation. Observes the accessibility tree, gates risky actions behind one-time approval, permanently refuses secure fields, and returns bounded visual evidence — through a native helper you build and grant locally.

Database connections and SQL for DeepSeek Harness: register data sources, browse and comment schemas, run AST-checked SQL with a per-source read-only toggle, and render bar, line and pie charts, from chat or the Settings page.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的数据库连接与 SQL 插件：注册数据源，浏览并注释表结构，通过 AST 校验执行 SQL（每个数据源可单独切换只读），并渲染柱状图、折线图和饼图，可在对话或设置页中使用。

description.en: Captain-led multi-agent teams that split a goal into tasks and dispatch them along an execution chain to members running in their own sub-sessions, each with its own model.
description.zh: 领队主导的多智能体团队：把目标拆成任务，按执行链派发给运行在各自子会话里的成员，每个成员可配不同模型。

description.en: fal.ai native image generation for DSH: a FAL_KEY settings card plus Agent tools (fal_generate_image / fal_edit_image) that call queue.fal.run directly.
DSH Web GUI 的 Git 面板插件：在会话界面的标签栏里，紧挨「对话 / 轨迹」再加一个 Git 页， 用来完成日常的查看改动、暂存、提交、看 diff、翻历史、切分支和推拉。
description.zh: 在会话页里加一个 Git 页，随手查看改动、暂存提交、看 diff、翻历史、切分支和推拉。

description.en: Configurable Git commit and pull request prompt instructions for DeepSeek Harness
Expose every model in your local DeepSeek Harness to the LAN over OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints.

Your AI agent keeps repeating the same mistakes? Give it a LESSONS.md notebook — it records its own failures into rules, auto-escalates repeat offenders, and you watch it all live in the DSH Web UI. 零 Key，让 DSH 的 AI 自己记错题、面板一眼看清。
Trellis workflow enforcement for the DeepSeek Harness: per-turn workflow state injection and a trellis-start entry gate, replacing the session-start and user-prompt hooks dsh does not ship.

DeepSeek Harness plugin that does QA: an agent explores your app like a real user and leaves evidence, then the explored path is exported as a deterministic replay scenario you run every release. Orchestrates the browser, macOS desktop, iOS and Android drivers — never a false green.

Mobile-first QoL for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: Chrome-style session tab bar, swipeable fullscreen sidebar, keyboard/IME/touch adaptations and a rewritten settings page — 13 toggles under Settings → QoL.
DSH Web GUI plugin: VSCode-style Ctrl+P quick open — indexed workspace file search, sidebar editor open, conversation reference insert
Standalone read-only Linux server monitoring sidebar for DeepSeek Harness

DeepSeek Harness plugin: one model-facing shell tool whose shell (PowerShell, cmd, Git Bash, WSL, bash, zsh, fish, sh) is a user setting, with a Web settings card and a fail-closed refusal when the sandbox cannot confine it.

Pre-flight check for a DeepSeek Harness profile's plugin tree: static checks + optional isolated real-boot and headless-browser smoke, with instance-shutdown confirmation and stray-instance audit. Provides the plugin_check tool and the bundled plugin-fault-diagnosis skill.

Speaks or plays a sound at the end of every turn and plays a failure cue when a tool call or a turn errors. Ships 20 built-in effects (10 alert chimes + 10 nature sounds) and defaults to effect mode, so it needs no API key and no audio files; an optional Volcengine voice-clone route generates the three announcement clips in one click. Plays through winmm/waveOut as-is, never changing the system volume or mute state. Windows only.
description.zh: 每个 turn 结束自动语音/音效提醒，出错时播失败提示；内置 20 个音效（提醒 10 + 大自然 10）且默认「音效」模式，零配置开箱即用、不需要任何 API Key 与音频文件；进阶可用火山「声音复刻」克隆自己的音色并一键生成三条播报语音；走 winmm/waveOut 原样播放，绝不改动系统音量或静音状态。仅 Windows。

description.en: Voice-feedback plugin for DeepSeek Harness: speak tool, verbalizer, per-session voices, chimes, monitoring, native pet. zh/en i18n.
description.zh: 让 DSH 助手用语音播报结果、决策点和提醒，还能按会话换音色、加提示音。

description.en: DSH-native reproductions of published agent harnesses, with Web presets and headless experiment profiles.
Maintains stable emoji session titles in DeepSeek Harness after user prompts without adding naming messages.
description.zh: 在用户消息后为 DeepSeek Harness 维护稳定的 emoji 会话标题，不向原会话追加命名消息。

description.en: AlphaRSI — three-role self-improvement loop that evolves the training recipe of alpha sequence models. Operator runs walk-forward, Evaluator grades with OOS RankIC, Refiner proposes hyperparameters via TPE Bayesian search; only strictly-better recipes are kept. Offline one-command run, data bundle shipped with sha1 reconciliation, GPU auto-detect. Ships one skill.
description.zh: AlphaRSI——三角色自改进闭环，进化 alpha 序列模型的训练配方。Operator 跑 walk-forward、Evaluator 用 OOS RankIC 验收、Refiner 用 TPE 贝叶斯搜索提议超参，只保留严格更优。离线一条命令跑，数据包 sha1 对账分发，GPU 自动走 CUDA。附带一个 skill。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that enforces the mechanically verifiable part of an agent's Basic Memory policy — recall before mutation — while leaving semantic judgement to the model.

DeepSeek Harness plugin for browser automation, headless first. Every agent gets its own throwaway Chrome/Edge/Chromium profile, short-lived semantic references instead of CSS selectors, scoped subtree observation, deterministic high-risk refusal, and bounded evidence.
Context compaction for DeepSeek Harness: mind_map and clear_mind agent tools turn selected history into self-written checkpoints, with auditable GUI tombstones and proactive threshold reminders.

DeepSeek Harness（dsh）Web 插件。输入框上方常驻一条汇率/行情跑马灯，可混排货币对、A股指数与加密货币；点开任一标的看走势图，并按市场自身时区标注交易时段。另有汇率计算器（24 个货币对）、一键开关、信源可选（新浪 / ECB / ER-API）、刷新间隔可调。数据全部免密钥。由 DeepSeek-V41-Flash 编写。 A dsh plugin: a live FX ticker strip above the composer, with trend charts and a currency calculator. Written by DeepSeek-V41-Flash.
description.zh: 在输入框上方常驻汇率行情跑马灯，看走势图、算汇率，免密钥即开即用。

description.en: kaze tachinu theme for DSH Web GUI,thank you visit
Control how the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI is reachable: local only, Tailscale, all local networks, or off.
DeepSeek Harness notification center with interactive Windows question and approval cards
description.zh: 在 Windows 桌面弹出可交互的提问和审批卡片，让你随时处理 DeepSeek Harness 的通知。

description.en: RCOS operator control plane for DeepSeek Harness — GoalRunner, authority gates with explicit approval, three-truth verification (execution / capability / objective satisfaction), trust ladder and next-action, task identity rebuilt from Archon runs. Side-loaded, no fork.
Runtime-switchable outbound HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy for DSH with a web settings card.
description.zh: DSH 运行时可切换的出站 HTTP/SOCKS5 代理，带网页设置卡片。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面换字体。 Change the font for the DeepSeek Harness web interface.

Routes model requests, web fetches/searches and spawned tools through the Windows system proxy or a custom address — idempotent kernel (reads never rebuild the dispatcher), header one-click toggle, per-URL route diagnosis and NTLM-aware 407 hints.
description.zh: 把模型请求、web 抓取/搜索与衍生工具统一路由到 Windows 系统代理或自定义地址——幂等内核（读操作不重组分发器）、头部一键开关、按 URL 路由诊断与 NTLM 认证提示。

description.en: Role-based subagent delegation for DeepSeek Harness: one delegate tool over a folder of role files
DeepSeek Harness agent tool (session_search) for full-text search across historical sessions

Skill routing for DeepSeek Harness: embeds skills and each user task with a local model, keeps the clearly-relevant skills with a gap-based selection rule, and auto-injects their full bodies into the prompt.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 skill 路由插件：用本地模型为 skill 和用户任务生成向量，按基于分差的规则保留明确相关的 skill，并自动把它们的完整正文注入提示词。

description.en: Delete a complete closed turn (question + answer + tool calls) from a DeepSeek Harness session, without deleting the session.
description.zh: 删除 DeepSeek Harness 会话中的一整轮对话（提问 + 回答 + 工具调用），不影响会话本身。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI plugin: real-time spend for the current session, priced from per-model token rates and shown as a pill under the composer
Keep the Windows console on code page 65001 (UTF-8) for the dsh host and its bash tool commands, so output from Windows-native child processes stops being decoded as mojibake
description.zh: 让 Windows 控制台固定用 UTF-8 编码，dsh 和 bash 命令的中文输出不再乱码

description.en: 适合编码研发的UI界面
description.zh: 把文件树、代码编辑预览和 AI 对话放在同一屏，边看代码边聊，开发不用来回切窗口。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: customize the Web GUI fonts (interface font, code font, and font sizes) from Settings
description.zh: 在设置里自由更换 Web 界面的字体和字号，界面字体、代码字体都能单独调。

description.en: Make a Git for Windows installation resolvable as bash inside the dsh host process, so the official bash shell stack can run on Windows
description.zh: 让 Windows 上的 Git Bash 能被 dsh 直接调用，官方 bash 工具链终于跑起来了

description.en: In-process DeepSeek Harness subagent provider that seeds each child with a bounded window of the parent’s completed conversation instead of the entire transcript.
description.zh: 给子智能体只喂父会话最近几轮对话，省 token 又不丢上下文，多智能体协作更轻快。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 用量统计插件：本地 SQLite 账本，按天 / 服务商 / 模型统计 token 用量
description.zh: 把每次模型调用的 token 用量记进本地账本，按天、服务商、模型分类统计，删会话也不丢数据。

description.en: deepseek harness的git工具
Insight dock for the DSH Web GUI: an agent parks a short, strictly-bounded side observation while it works; you decide later whether to hear it.
description.zh: 让 AI 干活时把冒出的零碎想法先存到侧边栏，你之后再决定要不要听。

description.en: You.com search + fetch provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh), plus a research-focused agent preset
description.zh: 给 dsh 接上 You.com 的搜索和抓取能力，还带一个专攻深度研究的智能体预设。

description.en: Runtime steering for DeepSeek Harness (Cordis): a one-click ⏩ that injects your message into the running turn instead of queueing it.

Controlled browser automation for DeepSeek Harness: the agent_browser tool and BrowserAutomationService drive a real Chromium or Chrome page (or an explicit CDP endpoint) through the agent-browser CLI, with allowedDomains containment and per-call output limits.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的受控浏览器自动化：agent_browser 工具与 BrowserAutomationService 通过 agent-browser CLI 驱动真实 Chromium / Chrome 页面（或指定 CDP 端点），支持 allowedDomains 域名收敛与单次调用输出上限。

description.en: Password-optional LAN entry for the DSH Web GUI. DSH stays loopback-only while a settings-card plugin serves its HTTP and WebSocket traffic on port 3301, storing the password only as a scrypt verifier.
description.zh: 将DSH Web GUI代理到3301端口供局域网访问。口令可选，无明文保存，初始3080端口保存回环不暴露。

description.en: 泡泡猫 DSH 插件合集 — 一条命令装好全部精选插件，新手开箱即用
